Arsound — мод для Android-приложения SoundCloud со скачиванием треков, своей музыкой с телефона и плейлистами, которые открываются сразу.

**Готовый APK** (ставится без ReVanced Manager) — в Telegram-канале [t.me/arsound_git](https://t.me/arsound_git). Здесь, на GitHub, — набор патчей для ReVanced Manager.

Всё делается на телефоне, компьютер не нужен. Займёт 5–10 минут.

## Установка кратко

1. Установите [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/download/v2.6.0/revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk) и [загрузчики для ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager-downloaders/releases/download/v1.2.0/revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk). Загрузчики открывать не нужно — они работают внутри ReVanced Manager.
2. ReVanced Manager → **Патчи** → ✏️ → **Добавить патчи** → **Введите URL** → `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json` → **Добавить**.
3. **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** → на APKMirror: **2026.09.02-release**, **arm64-v8a**, **Download APK bundle** → **Установить**.

Ниже — подробная инструкция с пояснениями к каждому шагу.

---

# Установка по шагам

Понадобятся: телефон на Android 8.0 или новее, интернет (лучше Wi-Fi — скачается около 100 МБ) и аккаунт SoundCloud.

Ниже названия кнопок написаны **жирным** — ровно так, как они подписаны на экране. Если ReVanced Manager у вас на английском, в скобках указано английское название.

## Шаг 1. Скачайте и установите ReVanced Manager

ReVanced Manager — официальное приложение проекта ReVanced. Оно встраивает Arsound в SoundCloud.

1. Откройте на телефоне ссылку: **[revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/download/v2.6.0/revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk)**. Начнётся скачивание файла.
2. Когда файл скачается, нажмите на уведомление о загрузке (или откройте «Файлы» → «Загрузки» и нажмите на `revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk`).
3. Если Android напишет, что установка из этого источника запрещена, нажмите **Настройки**, включите переключатель **Разрешить из этого источника** и вернитесь назад кнопкой «Назад».
4. Нажмите **Установить**.
5. Если появится окно Google Play Защиты о неизвестном приложении — нажмите **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.
6. Дождитесь надписи «Приложение установлено» и нажмите **Готово**.

## Шаг 2. Скачайте и установите загрузчики для Manager

Это дополнение к Manager: благодаря ему Manager сам скачает SoundCloud нужной версии.

1. Откройте ссылку: **[revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager-downloaders/releases/download/v1.2.0/revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk)**.
2. Установите файл так же, как в шаге 1: нажмите на скачанный файл → **Установить** → **Готово**.

Открывать это дополнение не нужно — у него нет своего экрана, оно работает внутри Manager.

## Шаг 3. Добавьте Arsound в Manager

1. Нажмите и удерживайте эту ссылку, затем выберите **Копировать ссылку** (или выделите текст и скопируйте):
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json
   ```
2. Откройте приложение **ReVanced Manager**.
3. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Патчи** (Patches).
4. В правом нижнем углу нажмите круглую кнопку с **карандашом ✏️**.
5. Внизу появится кнопка **+ Добавить патчи** — нажмите её.
6. В окне «Добавить патчи» оставьте выбранным **Введите URL** (Enter URL) и нажмите **Далее**.
7. Нажмите на поле **URL патчей**, удерживайте палец и выберите **Вставить** — в поле появится скопированная ссылка.
8. Галочку **Автообновление** оставьте включённой — тогда новые версии Arsound будут приходить сами.
9. Нажмите **Добавить**.

Проверка: на вкладке «Патчи» появилась строка **Arsound v0.3.0 • 8 патчей**. Строка «ReVanced Patches» — это официальные патчи ReVanced, её трогать не нужно.

## Шаг 4. Пропатчите SoundCloud

1. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Приложения** (Apps).
2. Нажмите на строку поиска **Поиск приложений…** и напишите `SoundCloud`.
3. Нажмите на **com.soundcloud.android**. Под названием должна быть версия **2026.09.02-release**.
   Если там другая версия — смотрите «Частые вопросы» ниже.
4. Откроется экран «Информация о приложении». Ничего менять не нужно: все патчи Arsound уже выбраны. Нажмите синюю кнопку **Патч** (Patch) в правом нижнем углу.
5. Появится окно «APKMirror — Для продолжения работы этого загрузчика требуется взаимодействие с пользователем». Нажмите **Продолжить**.
6. Внутри Manager откроется сайт APKMirror (он на английском). Дальше:
   1. Немного пролистайте вниз до «Results for …» и нажмите на **SoundCloud: The Music You Love 2026.09.02-release**.
   2. На открывшейся странице нажмите оранжевую кнопку **SCROLL TO AVAILABLE DOWNLOADS**.
   3. Появится таблица вариантов. Нажмите на оранжевую надпись **2026.09.02-release** в строке, где в колонке «Arch» написано **arm64-v8a** (обычно это первая строка). Это вариант для почти всех современных телефонов.
   4. На странице варианта пролистайте немного вниз до оранжевой кнопки **DOWNLOAD APK BUNDLE** и нажмите её.
   Реклама на сайте — это реклама APKMirror, её можно просто пролистывать.
7. Manager сам вернётся к экрану «Патчер» и начнёт работу. Вы увидите три этапа: **Подготовка**, **Патчинг**, **Сохранение** — возле каждого по очереди появятся зелёные галочки. Это занимает 2–5 минут. Не сворачивайте Manager и не блокируйте телефон.
8. Когда все три этапа станут зелёными, внизу справа появится кнопка **Установить** (Install). Нажмите её.
9. Android спросит, установить ли приложение, — нажмите **Установить**. Если появится предупреждение Google Play Защиты — **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.

## Шаг 5. Откройте Arsound

1. На рабочем столе или в списке приложений появится **Arsound** со своей иконкой.
2. Откройте его и войдите в свой аккаунт SoundCloud.
3. Настройки мода: значок профиля или **Library** → шестерёнка ⚙️ → пункт **Arsound**.

Оригинальный SoundCloud удалять не нужно — Arsound ставится отдельным приложением рядом с ним.

---

# Как обновить Arsound

Когда выйдет новая версия, Manager подтянет её сам (если в шаге 3 была включена галочка «Автообновление»). Чтобы обновить приложение: откройте ReVanced Manager → **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** и повторите шаг 4. Arsound обновится поверх, настройки и вход сохранятся.

---

# Частые вопросы

**Под com.soundcloud.android в Manager написана не 2026.09.02-release, а другая версия.**
Нажмите на com.soundcloud.android → **Выберите патчи** → в правом нижнем углу круглая кнопка со **стрелкой и часами** (сброс) → внизу появится надпись «Выбор патчей и параметры были сброшены до рекомендуемых значений» → нажмите **Сохранить**. Вернитесь назад — версия станет 2026.09.02-release.

**Строка Arsound на вкладке «Патчи» красная или пишет, что патчи не могут быть загружены.**
Проверьте интернет и что ссылка вставлена полностью. Удалите строку (✏️ → значок корзины → **Подтвердить**) и добавьте заново по шагу 3.

**Сайт APKMirror не открывается или показывает проверку «Verify you are human».**
Отметьте проверку на сайте сами, как в обычном браузере, и продолжайте с пункта 6.1.

**При установке пишет «Приложение не установлено».**
На телефоне уже есть Arsound, установленный другим способом. Удалите его (удерживайте иконку Arsound → **Удалить**) и нажмите **Установить** в Manager ещё раз.

**Android спрашивает «Открыть с помощью: SoundCloud / Arsound».**
Выберите **Arsound**.

**Трек пишет «Недоступно в вашей стране», хотя в обычном SoundCloud играет.**
В Arsound: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound** → **Сбросить данные SoundCloud**. Вход в аккаунт и настройки Arsound сохранятся.

---

# Что умеет Arsound

Всё включается и выключается в приложении: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound**.

- **Без лишнего** — нет предложений подписки Go и Go+, телеметрия выключена, вкладку Upgrade можно скрыть.
- **Скачивание** — «Скачать файл» в меню трека, проверка скачивания плейлиста без дублей, скачанное играет без интернета.
- **Своя музыка** — импорт аудиофайлов с телефона, плейлист «Импортированные», любые треки в любых плейлистах, свой порядок плейлистов перетаскиванием.
- **Мгновенные плейлисты** — плейлисты и альбомы открываются сразу, даже без интернета.
- **Сеть и батарея** — свой DNS, запрет выхода в сеть с российского IP, плашка статуса сети, вопрос перед проверкой устройства, экономия батареи.
- **Без дубликатов** — перезаливы одного трека скрываются в рекомендациях и на главной.

HushThreads v0.0.4 has 10 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it works with Threads 448.0.0.54.85 too. Four of the patches are new, and the share links you hand out are cleaner.

## New patches

- **Open links in browser** opens a web link you tap in Threads in your own browser, or in the app Android picks for that site, instead of Threads' built-in browser. A link wrapped in Threads' click tracker goes out as its real address with `fbclid` and the other tracking tags taken off. Threads, Instagram, Facebook and Meta pages stay in Threads so sign-in and Accounts Center keep working. It's on by default and has its own switch under Privacy.
- **Disable video autoplay** keeps videos in your feed, on profiles and in threads on their cover frame as you scroll. Tap one and it plays full screen with Threads' usual controls. It's off by default, so pick it in Manager if you want it.
- **Block background-return feed refresh** keeps your place in For you when you come back to Threads within ten minutes, or after any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still load new posts. It's off by default too.
- **Hide suggested users** takes the cards that suggest accounts to follow out of your feed. It has its own switch, and ordinary posts and reposts stay where they are.

## Changes

- **Sanitize sharing links** now hands out the post's own link, `threads.com/@name/post/code`, in place of Threads' short share link. Threads makes a new short link every time you share, each one tied to that share. Copy link gives you the clean link now.
- Threads 448.0.0.54.85 for arm64 is supported alongside 449.0.0.54.82. All 10 patches apply to both.
- Safe mode got a full check on a Galaxy S22. If Threads crashes three times in a row right after it starts, HushThreads pauses itself on the next start so you can get back in, with your switches kept. Resume brings every patch back.
- The Pause, Resume and Undo button next to HushThreads' status is bigger and easier to tap.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.32.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.4 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads **449.0.0.54.82** (version code 511908382) or **448.0.0.54.85** (version code 511808302).
3. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
4. Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

448 runtime tests and 156 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 10 patches applied without forcing to Threads 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check passed.

HushPinterest 0.0.4 has 20 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0, and Pinterest 14.25.0 still patches the same way for phones on Android 9. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. New this time are Hide save toasts, Original-quality images, a Hide Search button switch, Copy media link, Set as wallpaper in Download history and a Hide advertising ID patch that's selected by default.

## What's new

- New Hide save toasts patch. Saving a pin no longer pops up "Saved to" your board or the suggestion to follow the pin's creator, and the pin still saves as usual. Pick the patch in Morphe Manager, then turn on its switch on the Interface page. Turning it off or pausing HushPinterest brings the pop-ups back.
- New optional Original-quality images patch. With its switch on, Pinterest's image model hands back the original image ahead of the large size wherever Pinterest supplied one. It uses more data, so the switch starts off.
- Hide navigation buttons has a third switch, Hide Search button, beside Create and Notifications. It starts off. Home and Profile always stay in the bottom bar.
- Hide navigation buttons keeps a hidden tab hidden when Pinterest rebuilds it, such as Search after you close a pin.
- With Download pins on, the pin menu has a Copy media link row under Download pin. It copies the address of the same original image or MP4 the download would save, read from the pin when you tap it, and it's only offered when Pinterest supplied one.
- Download history offers Set as wallpaper for a finished image download on Android 10 and newer. It opens Android's own Set as options for the saved file, and HushPinterest needs no wallpaper permission.
- Choose up to 32 visible pins from a grid menu. Each selection uses Pinterest's supplied media, reports its queue or save result and appears in Download history. Android 9 opens one save picker at a time. Stopping leaves downloads already started alone.
- Hide ads now also keeps Google's mobile ads SDK from starting when Pinterest opens. Pinterest only starts it for accounts in its Google ads test, and with the SDK idle no Google ad is requested or shown. Turning Hide ads off or pausing HushPinterest lets it start again on the next launch.
- New Hide advertising ID patch, on by default. Pinterest and the ad and analytics code bundled in it read an all-zero ad ID with ad tracking limited, the answer Android gives after you delete your ad ID. Its switch is on the Privacy page, and turning it off or pausing HushPinterest hands back the real ID.
- Disable analytics now also stops Bugsnag crash and session reports, and it keeps Pinterest from publishing recommendations to Google Engage (the Collections and similar Google surfaces). Engage gets the same "service not found" answer as a phone without it. The switch and Pause bring both back.
- Profile header and About website buttons can now open the Android browser chooser. Pinterest, account and sign-in links keep their native path, as do all links while the switch is off or HushPinterest is paused.
- System share sheet looks up how Pinterest closes its share sheet in each supported build, including 14.25.0 for Android 9, so the Share button at the top of a pin uses that build's own close step after handing the link to Android.
- HushPinterest now builds on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Manager 1.33.0 carries patcher 1.15.0 and asks for an update before it'll load the bundle.
- Pin-menu reports count recognized optional rows and their visibility decisions without collecting row text or recording unknown entries.
- Reports now show local push readiness, including notification permission, delegation and messaging component state. They keep live delivery unverified and omit private component names and unknown delegate packages.

## Tooling

- A hook can no longer borrow a register that its own call still reads, and the patch checks refuse a hook call that passes one register twice unless Pinterest's own call already did.
- The source census is refreshed for 2026-10-05. It records oyasumi's newer Pinterest patches, six more forks, two false matches and the five indexes that now list HushPinterest. Still no outside Pinterest code is adopted.
- The release receipt runs the resource table and injected code checks on every fixture it patches, the same ones as the patch verification script, including every class and member the injected code calls. Any finding stops the receipt.
- The fixture checks run on desktop CLI 1.18.1, which carries patcher 1.15.1. The patcher's new ARSCLib commit is pinned in the dependency verification metadata, with hashes matched against fresh downloads.
- Invalid object and wide-register copies stay unknown during disabled-path checks. Initialized values retain their type when loops merge, so valid copies keep their identity without inventing equality between unrelated values.
- Disabled-path checks now follow copied object references and long/double register pairs, including overlapping moves, null aliases and NaN comparisons.
- First installs now handle Android's empty package-path response safely by confirming that the package is absent. Existing signer and downgrade checks still apply.
- The script contract tests run to the end under Windows PowerShell 5.1 as well as PowerShell 7.

## Update from 0.0.3

1. Update [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) to 1.34.0 or newer. Older versions carry patcher 1.15.0 and ask for an update before they'll load this bundle.
2. Morphe Manager offers 0.0.4 from the HushPinterest patch source. Patch the same Pinterest build you have now and install it over your current Pinterest. Your sign-in and switches stay, as long as Morphe Manager signs it with the same key as before.
3. Hide advertising ID is new and selected by default. Hide save toasts and Original-quality images are new and start unselected, so pick them in Morphe Manager if you want them, then turn on their switches in HushPinterest settings.

## New install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.38.0**, version code **14388010**, as the universal APK, and patch it. On Android 9, use Pinterest **14.25.0**, version code **14258020**.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 156 patch tests and 670 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto real Pinterest 14.38.0 and 14.25.0 APKs with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 20 patches applied to both without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.4.json` records each of those results, the APK hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

On a signed-in Android 16 phone running patched 14.38.0, an update signed with the same key installed over the existing patched app and kept its sign-in and switches. Hide save toasts took away the "Saved to" and follow pop-ups when a pin was saved, and they came back with the switch off. With Hide ads on, Google's ad SDK stayed idle when Pinterest opened, and it started again once Hide ads was off. Copy media link copied a video pin's MP4 address. Hide Search button kept Search out of the bottom bar after closing a pin, opening Saved and going back Home, and turning the switch off brought Search back. On a second Android 16 phone, choosing two of four visible pins from a grid menu queued the video and reported the pin that had nothing to download, and both stayed in Download history after a restart.

Initial release of the rebuilt repository using the official Morphe Gradle layout.

HushTelegram v0.0.9 has 25 patches for telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`) and the official Telegram beta 12.10.7 (`org.telegram.messenger.beta`), up from 22 in v0.0.8. Twenty-three are selected by default. The two credential patches take your own values, so they stay off until you pick them.

## What's new

* **Telegram:** Repair Firebase push registration now works on slower phones. Firebase starts its first Installations request while Telegram is still starting, and on a slow phone that request could get there before HushTelegram's settings were ready. It then went out with the re-signed certificate, Firebase refused it, and no push token was saved. The request now waits for the settings, up to 10 seconds, on Firebase's own background thread. The diagnostic report counts requests that waited and any that still went out early.
* **Telegram:** The beta target is now telegram.org's current 12.10.7 build, version code 71179, which replaced build 71159. Every patch applies and passes its fixture tests on it.
* **Telegram:** The README says every way into HushTelegram settings (Telegram's own Settings, a long-press on the Telegram icon, or App info), and walks through the my.telegram.org form for your own API ID, including what causes "Incorrect app name!".
* **Telegram:** Three independent switches add plain-text paste, copyable local user and chat IDs, and a way to stop double-tap reactions. They start off. Pause restores the stock behavior, and the existing clipboard and explicit reaction actions stay available.
* **Telegram:** Pause, Settings backup and Diagnostics now have separate pages with shorter headings. Search still reaches every control, and all five translations include the new page names.
* **Telegram:** New Year look all year now puts Telegram's Santa hat over the chat list logo. It follows the logo's bounds and color so it stays visible in light and dark themes. Other titles keep their original drawing path. Changed title geometry getters refuse before patching. The switch remains off by default, and Pause restores Telegram's seasonal behavior.
* **Telegram:** External links now recognize browser aliases that Android enables at runtime, even when their manifest default is disabled. Disabled or private components stay excluded, and the browser chooser keeps its existing order.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram settings now opens from a row in Telegram's own Settings. Repeated taps share one screen, and the launcher and Android App-info entries remain available. Partial patch selections show only their installed controls. Changed incoming item registers or callback casts refuse before any hook is edited.
* **Telegram:** Changing the registered API ID now refreshes the native connection identity for every valid ID. IDs that differ by 128 no longer share a marker. Updates also stay distinct from the previous marker scheme, without changing saved account keys or the app version. Changed native argument shapes refuse before either credential is edited.

### Tooling

* **Tooling:** Builds use Morphe patcher 1.15.1, which brings faster fingerprint matching and signing, and stricter DEX path checks. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 is the first stable Manager that carries it, so the README now asks for 1.34.0 or newer. Fixture checks use the desktop CLI 1.18.1.
* **Tooling:** The source-ledger paragraph now identifies v0.0.8 as the published bundle and distinguishes newer source changes.
* **Tooling:** A bounded selection matrix checks both declared Telegram builds 41 ways each, from the defaults and the full catalog down to single patches and bad credential options. It checks each build's dependencies, minimum Android version, preserved resources, native libraries and settings switches. Configured credentials must change only their own values and the native connection version marker. Mutation controls reject missing, duplicated or altered markers.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram **12.10.6** from [telegram.org/android](https://telegram.org/android) by tapping Download Telegram (it saves as plain `Telegram.apk`), or the [official beta](https://telegram.org/dl/android/apk-public-beta) **12.10.7**, and patch it. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from v0.0.8? Patch again and install over it with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put one over the other. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram won't send you a login code, register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps). Use only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select **Use registered Telegram API credentials**, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.
7. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## Validation

HushThreads v0.0.11 has 11 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it works with Threads 448.0.0.54.85 too. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer before you patch. The new patch in this one is Pure black dark mode.

## Threads

- New Pure black dark mode patch. In dark mode your feed, posts and profiles sit on pure black instead of Threads' #101010 dark gray, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus and sheets keep their own grays. It isn't selected by default. Once you pick it, its switch is on and lives on a new Appearance page in HushThreads settings, and a change takes effect after Threads restarts. Pause and safe mode hand the gray back.
- HushThreads now builds on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Manager 1.33.0 asks for an update before it loads the bundle.
- The sign-in section of the README now suggests resetting your Instagram password when Threads turns down one you know is right. That's what fixed it for the person who reported it.
- Signing in now has a device check on Threads 448.0.0.54.85 too. A typed password reaches the feed with only the settings patch or with all 11, and repatching with more patches on the same key keeps you signed in with your switches as you left them. With HushGram on the same key, your Instagram account shows up as a tile that signs you in without a password.

## Tooling

- A fixture test checks on 449 and 448 that the patch finds every #101010 load in Threads' theme and the background slots of its dark color scheme, hooks only those, and refuses to patch when the gray moves, the scheme builder branches, or one scheme serves both modes.
- ARSCLib follows the patcher to 9b742c412d, with hashes checked against the cached files. smali stays at d856bad65f, which 1.15.1 still asks for. The fixture gates move to desktop CLI 1.18.1.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer. Manager 1.33.0 asks for an update before it loads this bundle. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.11 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads **449.0.0.54.82** (version code 511908382) or **448.0.0.54.85** (version code 511808302).
3. Want pure black? Pure black dark mode isn't selected by default, so tick it in Manager before you patch.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
5. Sign in with your Instagram username and password. If you patch Instagram with [HushGram](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram) using the same signing key, you can tap your Instagram account on Threads' login screen instead.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

518 runtime tests and 191 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 11 patches applied without forcing to Threads 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85, and the release receipt records both runs. The dependency advisory check passed.

This release gathers everything since v0.7.1 and brings 70 patches for Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, up from 60. 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work, and phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch 581 now too. The ten new ones are `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, `Turn off HDR brightness`, `Picture-in-picture`, `Turn off screen transitions`, `Turn off haptics`, `Block Instant Games ads`, `Hide tabs`, `Block screenshot detection`, `Allow screenshots` and `Hold back analytics uploads`. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is required.

New in this release

- New patch, `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, in the default selection with its switch under Marketplace. A seller's page in Marketplace has Facebook's own View profile button, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile, but Facebook only gives it to some accounts. Everyone else gets Follow, Message and More, with no way to check who's selling. With the switch on, every seller's page has View profile next to More and in the More sheet too (issue #68).

- New patch, `Turn off HDR brightness`, with its switch under Playback. Facebook turns the screen up for HDR videos and photos in the feed, stories and Reels, which flashes the screen brighter as you scroll past one. With the switch on they play in the screen's usual range at the same resolution, and on Android 15 and newer that covers videos Facebook plays on a surface of their own too. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. Off or paused, Facebook's HDR comes back from the next screen you open (issue #66).

- New patch, `Picture-in-picture`, with its switch under Playback. A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you go Home or switch apps. A paused reel doesn't open one, and after a swipe the window plays the reel you swiped to. It's the picture-in-picture Facebook already built for its Reels viewer, which it turns on for some accounts, so the window is Facebook's own. It needs Android 12 or later, it's off in Manager's default selection, and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook picture-in-picture patch. Checked on a phone with 581: a playing reel went on playing in the window after Home, a paused one opened no window, the reel a swipe brought up played in it, and with Tap to play on the reel being watched kept playing there.

- New patch, `Turn off screen transitions`, with its switch under Appearance. A tap on a tab or the Menu button shows that page at once instead of sliding to it, and a screen that opens over Facebook, like the post composer, appears and closes without its slide. Swiping between tabs still follows your finger. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on a tab, the Menu and the composer show at once, and with it off each slides in for about a quarter of a second as before.

- New patch, `Turn off haptics`, with its switch under Appearance. Facebook plays a short vibration on many of its own taps and gestures, and with the patch picked and its switch on, those don't play. Your keyboard, your phone's own haptics and a call's ring stay. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on the Menu button opens with no tick, and with it off the tick plays.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` has a new switch, Hide Meta AI in the feed, under News feed. It takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds to the feed between posts, by the card's own type, so people's posts stay whatever they say about AI. It starts on.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` also has a Hide AI character posts switch, right below that one. It takes out posts featuring one of Meta's AI characters, the Creator AI and AI Studio characters you can chat with, found by the attachment style Facebook draws a character with. Those are still someone's posts, so the switch starts off.

- Phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch Facebook 581.0.0.45.58. Pick its 32-bit build for Android 11 and newer, 475215364 on APKMirror. It keeps its code readable the way the 64-bit build does, and every patch applies to it.

- New patch, `Block Instant Games ads`, in the default selection with its switch under Menu. A game you play in Facebook that asks for an ad, whether a full-screen one, a rewarded one or a banner, is told there's none to show, the answer Facebook gives when it has no ad. So nothing is fetched or played, a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on. The idea comes from De-Vanced, which drops those asks.

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` also covers Marketplace's video ads. The two components that draw one in the feed draw nothing while the switch is on, and the ad's video isn't fetched. The diagnostic report counts them on its Marketplace ads line. The idea comes from De-Vanced's ad patch.

- New patch, `Hide tabs`, with a switch under Appearance for each of the Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming and Events tabs. Turn one on and that tab leaves the tab bar once Facebook restarts. Its page stays in the Menu and opens there on a screen of its own, and a start tab set to it opens Home. Checked on a phone with 581, with Friends and Marketplace hidden and then brought back. It's in Manager's default selection with every switch off. The idea comes from Loukious, which hides the Marketplace and Games tabs.

- New patch, `Block screenshot detection`, under Privacy. Facebook watches for screenshots across the app, in the feed, Reels, chats, games, Marketplace and ads, and on Android 14 and newer it can ask Android to report screenshots and screen recordings. With the patch picked and its switch on, it never finds out, so whatever it would do about a screenshot doesn't happen. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on, screenshots taken in the feed and in Reels never reach Facebook's screenshot check, and with it off they do. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot detection patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Allow screenshots`, under Privacy. Facebook blocks screenshots and screen recordings on a few pages, which come out black. With the patch picked and its switch on, those pages show up in screenshots, recordings and the recent apps view like any other. A page that's already open changes the next time you open it. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Hold back analytics uploads`, under a new Privacy section. Facebook uploads how you use the app in the background, every three minutes while it's open, and runs Papaya jobs that train models on your phone and report back. With the patch picked and its switch on, the uploads don't start and the Papaya jobs end without running. It's off in Manager's default selection, its switch starts on once it's picked, and a change takes a restart of Facebook.

- With the Saved shortcut switch on, Facebook's Menu gets a Saved row at the end of Settings and privacy, right above Hushfacebook settings. It opens your saved items inside Facebook, and unlike the icon's long-press entry it shows on Samsung phones too. It comes with `Hushfacebook in the Menu`.

- Block account setup reminders, under Notifications, stops the "finish setting up your account" notifications some people keep getting while they're signed in. It starts off like the other notification switches, and login and security alerts still come through (issue #57).

Fixes

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` now covers a listing's details page. Its ad rows, "Ads inspired by your views", "Ads from sellers" and "Suggested ad products", come from requests of their own, and those aren't sent anymore. Checked on a phone with 581, the page keeps everything else, from the description and the seller to related items, groups and searches.

- With Save videos other apps can open on, reels and stories that Facebook sends only as AV1 or VP9 picture with xHE-AAC sound now save at their full resolution. Those used to drop to Facebook's own MP4, which for a story can be 360p. The phone now turns the picture into H.264 and the sound into AAC-LC before joining them, which takes a few seconds for a 1080p reel, and the file keeps the colors the original states (issue #77).

- Resume long videos works again for long videos opened full screen. Facebook 581 plays those in its reels viewer, which loops what it plays, so they were skipped as reels. A reel of two minutes or more now resumes like any other long video, and shorter reels still start from the beginning.

- Under Material You, a wallpaper palette with almost no color in its accent no longer turns unseen story rings the same gray as watched ones. Facebook's own blue now stands in for an accent that gray, so unseen rings, unread dots and badges stay easy to tell apart, while the palette still colors the grays. A palette with some color in its accent looks as it did. The diagnostic report's new Material You section gives the accent's chroma (issue #67).

- At large text sizes on narrow screens, the settings home title stays on one line and the empty search field keeps its whole hint visible. Back and Clear search retain their touch targets.

- With `Hide the Reels tab` on, the Reels row in Facebook's Menu opens Reels on a screen of its own. Checked on a phone with 581.

- Messenger and Instagram rows no longer say links open here when Android's link handling is off or the relevant address states are missing. The rows refresh together from one Android answer when you return from settings.

- Hide sponsored reels now stops Facebook's Reels and Watch ad pool from handing an ad out at all. A report from a phone running 0.7.1 with 581 showed the Reels tab's loader drawing an ad from that pool one slot at a time, with the page filter catching it only after the pool had marked it used and logged its position. The pool now answers the way it does when no slot is free, so the loader goes on with the next reel. Facebook isn't serving reel ads to the test accounts here, so this change is built from that report; the diagnostic report counts each ad held back (issues #47 and #35).

Other changes

- Hide the Stories tray no longer waits for Facebook to restart. Turn it on or off and the tray goes or comes back the next time you pull the feed down to refresh. Facebook now builds the tray while it's hidden so it can come back without a restart.

- Hushfacebook now builds on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Manager 1.33.0 carries patcher 1.15.0 and asks for an update before it'll load the bundle.

- Checked on a phone with 581: the reel Download button, its quality choices and the save notification's Cancel all have spoken labels for TalkBack, at normal and double font size. With Check for new Hushfacebook releases on, the daily check runs as Facebook starts.

- Checked on Facebook 577 with every patch: Keep feed position on return holds your place through seven minutes away, and with it off Facebook reloads the feed as it always has. Pull to refresh and a fresh start still load new posts. Pause, the automatic pause after three crashed starts, Marketplace's held ad rows, reel saves with Open and Share, and the diagnostic report all work there too.

- The settings overview shows the version and a short build identity with its source state. About and diagnostic reports retain the full identity. At large text sizes, Pause, Resume and Undo appear before the recovery guidance so they stay in view.

- Installation help explains Expert mode and how to identify overlapping Facebook patch sources. Bug reports now ask for every source's version and patch selection, including the details needed to diagnose issue #79.

Behind the scenes

- Codec cleanup no longer fails a completed media test when closing the launcher's input retries a buffered release byte after the process has exited. Cleanup still reports errors while the launcher is alive.

- The fixture checks run on desktop CLI 1.18.1, which carries patcher 1.15.1. The patcher's new ARSCLib commit is pinned in the dependency verification metadata.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `581.0.0.45.58`. On most phones that's build `475215365`, which APKMirror labels (arm64-v8a) (320-640dpi) (Android 11+). Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475215364`, labelled (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+). Facebook `580.0.0.51.74`, build `475019344`, and `577.0.0.50.72`, build `474426275`, still work.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 1796 runtime tests and 746 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 70 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 (both builds), 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check found no advisory for gson 2.14.0, kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 or annotations 13.0.

# Haiagaru 1.7.2 プレリリース

1.7.1からの変更をまとめた検証用プレリリースです。配布するMPPはAndroid版Morphe向けです。安定版は引き続き1.7.1です。

## エッヂ過去ログ検索

- 前回の検索条件、ページ、検索結果、スクロール位置、詳細条件の開閉状態を保存するようにしました。検索画面を閉じて開き直した場合も復元します。
- 検索結果からスレ／レスを開いた後、Androidの「戻る」で検索結果へ戻るための遷移を追加しました。
- タブレット表示でも検索画面がホームへの転送で閉じないよう、過去ログ検索から開くスレは独立したスレ画面として表示します。通常のスレ表示には影響しません。
- 復元した結果は「前回の検索結果」と表示します。最新情報を取得したい場合は「検索」を押してください。

## 板単位のまとめて選択（241／242 dev）

- ホーム／履歴の複数選択モードで板名をタップすると、その見出しの下に表示されているスレをまとめて選択できます。すべて選択済みなら解除します。
- 他の板の選択は維持します。板名をタップしただけでは削除しません。選択後に既存の削除操作を行ってください。
- 191 dev／226 devの既存の板単位選択処理は変更していません。243 devは今回の追加対象外です。

## ツールバー・メニュー

- 「エッヂ過去ログ」「未読をすべて0にする」をスレ画面のツールバー設定と操作処理に追加しました。
- 上記のツールバー用項目が、レス長押しのダイアログへ混入しないようにしました。

## 互換性修正

- 191 dev／226 devで、文章末尾の「2ch.net」に次の行のURLのリンクが誤って付くケースを補正します。下線の範囲とクリック先を合わせて修正しました。
- 226 devで、書き込みボタン長押しの外部ブラウザ候補に別パッケージのChMateが混入するケースを修正しました。
- 191 dev／226 devで、タブレット表示の通常検索結果からスレを開く際の転送処理を修正しました。過去ログ検索からの戻る動線とは別の修正です。

## 対応・検証範囲

- 主な対象：ChMate 0.8.10.191 dev／0.8.10.226 dev／0.8.10.241／0.8.10.242 dev。
- BE／リンク補正の回帰テスト、241／242の板単位選択のロジックテストを実施しました。
- 191／241／242へのAPKパッチ適用を確認し、191 devはMi Note 10へインストールして起動確認済みです。
- 過去ログの検索保持・戻る動線、241／242の選択操作について、実機での一連の操作確認はまだ完了していません。226 devの今回の差分も実機確認が必要です。
- 243 devには一部未実装機能があるため、今回の検証対象には含めていません。

## 配布物・利用前の注意

- `haiagaru_patches-1.7.2.mpp` と `patches-1.7.2.mpp` は同一のAndroid向けMPPです。
- パッチ適用には元のChMate APKを使用してください。事前にバックアップをおすすめします。
- 不具合報告にはChMateの版、Haiagaruの版、操作手順を添えてください。試用に問題がある場合は安定版1.7.1をご利用ください。

## Parcello

- Add the **Disable ads** patch for Parcello `2.2.20` (Android 8.0+), removing AdMob ads, advertising consent prompts and sponsored/promotional banners.
- Preserve package tracking, barcode scanning, notifications and purchase entitlements.
- Parcello support is **experimental**.

## Updating

Refresh this patch source in Morphe Manager and re-patch an **original, unmodified APK/APKM** using the v1.4.0 bundle. Existing patched installations do not receive the SoundCloud fix automatically.

## Validation

Automated regression checks and local patching/DEX checks passed for both supported SoundCloud versions. All five patches together also passed resource and DEX output checks on `2026.09.23-release`. Parcello passed local patching, resource/DEX compilation and JavaScript behavior checks.

On-device validation is still pending. Parcello `2.2.20` and SoundCloud `2026.09.23-release` remain marked as experimental.

e00b76a3e6f9b22385e08f61:
First release. Four patches for RailOne (org.cris.aikyam):

- **Disable native security SDK** - stops `AikyamApplication.onCreate()` loading `libnative-lib.so` (root cause of the app force-stopping and wiping its own data on a re-signed build).
- **Bypass USB-debugging detection** - `adb_enabled`, `adb_wifi_enabled`, `development_settings_enabled` -> false.
- **Bypass signature verification** - the app's own SHA-256 certificate check -> true.
- **Bypass rjsniffer ADB check** - the `armys/rjsniffer` isolated-process check.

Verified on a Motorola Edge 50 Neo against RailOne 2.1.66: Morphe CLI applied all four patches to the real split bundle, the merged APK installed as an in-place upgrade, and the app stayed alive with USB debugging enabled (no anti-tamper wipe, no native-library failure).

Supply the app yourself; the bundle pins the genuine Play signing certificate and rejects a modified original.

Not affiliated with or authored by the Morphe project.

# Pixel Camera Morphe Patch v1.0.3

## Release Overview

* **Patch Version:** `1.0.3`
* **Target App:** Pixel Camera (`com.google.android.GoogleCamera`)
* **Target App Version:** `11.0.073.972752740.32`
* **Version Code:** `69623294`
* **Bundle MD5:** `9b3a5b29d3344940f86b516a9a4c2835`
* **Release Artifact:** `patches-1.0.3.mpp`
* **Alternative Filename:** `morphe-patches-pixelcamera-1.0.3.mpp`

---

## Critical Fixes

### Pixel 10 and Pixel 10 Pro 1× Photo Saving

Fixed an issue where photos captured at **1× zoom** could fail to save to MediaStore or disappear after capture. Photos captured at 5× and 10× could occasionally save successfully.

### Root Cause

The GCAM HDR+ post-processing pipeline was aborting during `FinishShot` because of an unhandled exception:

```text
IllegalStateException:
Unable to open Flare Removal model asset file
(ceftazidime_*.uncompressed)
```

The missing asset was requested by the Pixel 10 / Pixel 10 Pro hardware profile when processing wide-lens captures.

### Fixes Applied

* Added a fail-safe return inside `mkm.j` to prevent `FinishShot` from being aborted by flare-removal processing.
* Updated the `ejn` device profiles for:

  * Pixel 10 (`Blake`)
  * Pixel 10 Pro (`Frankel`)
* Disabled:

  * `camera.ceftazidime_enabled`
  * `camera.decepticon_enabled`
* Cleared references to missing uncompressed assets.
* Added runtime overrides forcing the following flags to `false`:

  * `camera.ceftazidime`
  * `camera.decepticon`
  * `camera.use_eclipse`
* Added sensor stream fallbacks for binned RAW dimensions:

  * `0x7e0`
  * `0x5e8`
* Added protection against `NullPointerException` when telephoto stream pointers are unavailable.

---

## Included Features and Patches

### Pixel 11 Camera Looks

Backports all **10 Pixel 11 Camera Looks** to Pixel 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 series devices.

Includes:

* Original
* Natural
* Shadows
* Vanilla
* Editorial
* Velvet
* Classic
* Digi
* Black Tie
* Minimal

Features include real-time viewfinder rendering and post-capture HDR+ grain and tone-map processing.

### Portrait Mode Fix

Improves portrait capture reliability by routing portrait depth generation through Google's monocular depth TFLite pipeline.

Addresses:

* Front-camera excessive blur
* Rear-camera portraits without bokeh
* Portrait depth generation failures across supported cameras

### Viewfinder Quick Access Controls

Adds customizable quick-access controls to the camera viewfinder.

Features:

* Configurable left shortcut
* Configurable right shortcut
* 10-step intensity control
* Real-time adjustment of supported Camera Look parameters

### 10× Viewfinder Quick Zoom

Adds a dedicated **10× quick zoom button** to the Photo mode viewfinder.

### Pixel Camera Creator Suite

Adds the following creator-focused tools:

**Teleprompter HUD**

Biotite-based teleprompter interface for displaying scripts while recording video.

**Live Audio VU Meter**

Mica-based real-time microphone level visualization.

**Social Framing Guides**

Slate-based framing guides for:

* 9:16
* 1:1
* 4:5

### Pro Manual Controls

Enables additional manual controls on supported non-Pro Pixel devices:

* Manual focus
* Shutter speed
* ISO
* Focus peaking
* Live control badges

### Non-Root Clone Mode

Provides an optional clone package name:

```text
com.google.android.GoogleCamera.morphe
```

This allows the patched camera to be installed alongside the stock Pixel Camera without requiring root.

---

## Installation

1. Open **Morphe Manager**.
2. Navigate to **Sources / Patches**.
3. Select `patches-1.0.3.mpp`.
4. Select the stock Pixel Camera APK/APKM:

   ```text
   11.0.073.972752740.32
   ```
5. Select **Pixel 10 Photo Saving Fix** and any additional features you want to enable.
6. Tap **Patch**.
7. Install the generated APK.

---

## Compatibility

**Target Pixel Camera version:**

```text
11.0.073.972752740.32
Version Code: 69623294
```

The patch is designed specifically for this Pixel Camera build. Using a different Camera version may result in failed patches, crashes, or unavailable features.

### THE REAL FIX

Patch CustomerInfo.getActiveSubscriptions() to return a non-empty set.

**Root cause:** The JS app checks `activeSubscriptions.length > 0` FIRST in `hasActiveEntitlementOrSubscription()`. If the user never subscribed, RevenueCat returns an empty set. Our `EntitlementInfo.isActive()` patch was useless because there were ZERO `EntitlementInfo` objects to call it on.

**Fix:** `CustomerInfo.getActiveSubscriptions()` now returns `Collections.singleton("premium")` so JS sees an active subscription and calls `setIsPremiumUser(true)`.

## What's new

- **AMOLED black theme.** New optional **AMOLED black theme** patch turns the whole dark appearance true black (`#000000`) — window, toolbars, tabs, nav drawer, cards, dialogs and backgrounds — so OLED/AMOLED screens switch those pixels off and battery life improves. The light appearance is untouched.
- **Rebranding is now on by default.** The recommended **Rebranding** patch renames the install/launcher package to `app.catsmoker.anime.witcher`, moves every `com.anime.witcher.*` permission under it and badges the icon with a red + — so the mod installs and runs even when the original app is still installed (fixes `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION` / `INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER`).
- **Configurable Telegram handle & About credit.** The `Rebranding: Telegram & About` sub-patch now exposes `telegram handle` and `about credit` options, so the support links and the About-screen credit line are fully customizable.
- **Faster, more reliable D-pad fix.** The Android TV support patch wires `TvFocusHelper` as an Activity lifecycle callbacks object, applies the focusability pass to every activity and every dialog the app shows, and only consumes a top-bar D-pad press once focus actually moved into a content row — so in-content D-pad navigation is left untouched.
- Website metadata on the patch source points to the original app page.

## Patches

| Patch | Default |
|---|---|
| AMOLED black theme | off |
| Android TV | off |
| Android TV: D-pad navigation | off |
| Disable VPN detection and alerts | on |
| Disable ads | on |
| Play with external player | on |
| Rebranding | on |
| Rebranding: Telegram & About | off |
| Remove AppLovin initialization | on |
| Remove startup popup | on |

Hide AI sticker tools now covers the Generate buttons in the sticker keyboard, and Allow screenshots covers view-once media and Quicksnap.

### New

- HushMessenger now patches Messenger **581.0.0.49.91** as well as 580.0.0.49.91 ([#29](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/29)). All 16 arm64 builds APKMirror lists for 581 pass the compatibility checks, and Morphe Desktop 1.18.1 applied all 33 patches to each of them with a 1 GB heap. On 581 the HushMessenger row sits right under Settings, above the new QR code row. The 580 builds patch exactly as before.
- Hide joined community chats is a new control that starts off. It filters subscribed channels and announcements from the main Chats list (the All chip) while keeping conversation data, delivery and unread state intact. Displayed row counts follow the filtered list. Off or Pause restores the original list on the next render. Other chips such as Channels and Unread, search and community folders keep their rows. Folder and membership checks cover all 21 supported builds.
- **Hide AI sticker tools** also hides the Generate buttons in Messenger's newer sticker keyboard. The guard matches the verified AI label and leaves other cells alone. **Allow screenshots** also covers the secure-window calls in view-once media and Quicksnap. It preserves unrelated flags, lifecycle code and the original calls while off or paused. All 21 supported builds have records for these routes.
- Settings expose each control's full row as one accessible switch. The title, description and activity label share a touch target, and the switch keeps its keyboard focus. Unavailable controls can be read but can't be toggled. Live TalkBack checks on an isolated Android 16 preview read the title and description as one control and changed the saved choice once per double-tap. The enabled-count summary stays readable without announcing after every toggle. Regression checks cover Android 9 and 16.

### Changed and fixed

- Patch builds now use Morphe Patcher 1.15.1 and the maintained MorpheApp ARSCLib fork. The tested tools are Morphe Manager 1.34.0 and Morphe Desktop 1.18.1. Migration checks applied all 32 patches to all 21 supported APKs at a 1024 MB heap, verified signatures for the five naming groups and retained their native libraries. Two fresh checkouts produced the same bundle bytes. Kotlin and Bouncy Castle security pins remain in place.
- The install check reads signer details from Android Build Tools 37 as well as 36.1. Build Tools 37 labels each signer with its signature scheme, and the check used to stop with "Cannot establish the complete current signer set" when it saw that format.
- The early v0.0.2 to v0.0.8 previews are no longer marked as pre-releases on GitHub. Catalogs that follow pre-releases kept offering v0.0.8 from them, and that stops on their next refresh.
- Inbox switches such as Hide People You May Know, friend requests and growth prompts now give one steady answer to each chat list Messenger builds. Messenger asks the same question when it lists a section, when it starts the section's loading and when it stops it, and a switch flipped in between now waits for the next chat list instead of splitting those steps. **Restart Messenger** applies a change everywhere at once.
- The full compatibility check now requires the exact stock APKs. Community fixtures use recorded stock identities, and media replay goes through shared discovery. Tests track fixture changes and reject duplicate builds that would leave another build untested.
- File tests now share Android's atomic-replace semantics on Windows, check post-commit read failures, and cover nonseekable restores on Android 16. Community discovery also reuses its constructor identifier in both scans.
- Retained unsent markers are capped at 4,096 IDs and no longer share the settings monitor. This only prunes markers, never message content.
- Choices saves check media-row ownership before opening the destination for writing. A picker can't use a Messenger-owned MediaStore row to overwrite its content.
- An original-photo success callback that throws no longer receives a second failure callback or loses the copy it was handed.
- Theme return hooks keep incoming branches attached to the color helper. Menu binding rejects reused holder registers before making changes, and the story Save helper is retained even when the patcher has already cached direct methods.
- Community filtering preserves the native list type and checks backward and switch branches before reusing temporary values. Screenshot support now stays unavailable if any matching viewer method changes, even when the original methods still exist. Other controls remain available.
- Profile recording now parses the rebuilt manifest, resource table and every DEX. A successful Desktop report and valid ZIP are no longer enough to accept malformed APK contents.
- Changed media-viewer or community code now leaves those controls unavailable while other patches can still apply. Community discovery runs once during setup and reuses fixed method identifiers while checking the APK. Manager 1.33.0 applied all 33 patches to Messenger 581 at its unchanged 640 MB limit, with a 288 MB peak.
- Closing settings or canceling an update check no longer waits for a slow cache write. Pending writes from canceled checks are discarded, and an older write cannot replace a newer result.
- Saving choices continues through rotation or closing settings, with the same 30-second limit and a completion or failure message. Closing the screen no longer cancels a save after its destination may have been emptied. Restores still cancel when settings close.
- Compatibility profiles now require Desktop to apply every patch and rebuild the APK before the record is written. Discovery alone could previously accept a changed menu or drawer that the patcher rejected. The check rejects incomplete results and changing input files.
- **Open** in settings and **Restart Messenger** now find Messenger when you've switched to one of its alternate app icons. They used to report that no launcher was available, because they read each icon's built-in default instead of whether Messenger had turned it on.
- Safe mode keeps counting startup crashes even when its saved count can't be read, so a crash loop still pauses the controls after three tries.
- Update checks recover on their own if GitHub's reply no longer matches the saved release details. A retry time from GitHub never holds checks back for more than a day, and it never shortens the normal wait between failed checks.
- Development release checks compare the held public feed with the one published under its release tag, and the development version must be newer. Catalog validation runs the Gradle wrapper directly and stops the whole process tree if it times out. The compatibility report keeps going when the community route changes on a new build, and the memory gate reports a damaged output APK without dropping the other results.
- The memory gate now checks every build of every supported Messenger version. It used to expect exactly 21 and would have refused to start once 581 was added.
- The memory gate runs at most two builds at once, with two processors per Java process. Compatibility and patching failures include their subprocess exit codes. Regression tests check that all inputs run without exceeding the concurrency limit.
- Focused dependency tests run five partial patch selections through compilation. A failed sibling keeps the successful patch, advertises no failed control and leaves its own native target unchanged. A later selection starts with no stale keys. Each run checks a single settings and extension injection.
- Opted-in update checks reuse validated release details for an hour and send their ETag on later checks. GitHub retry times are shown in settings and respected. Quota reset times apply only to an exhausted quota, so secondary limits keep their own retry wait. Release links must match their tags, and development builds ahead of the public release show both versions. Late replies can't save cache data after cancellation.
- Copy setup includes the control descriptions shown in settings and explains what recorded activity proves. Receipt wording keeps the local unread and reply limits explicit. Sign-in and past-call-log documentation now reflect the observed results.
- Original-quality photos enforce the 20 MB limit throughout preparation and delivery. Files that grow during a read or while a callback waits are rejected. Cleanup keeps the source and earlier copies intact. Existing scan bytes, color profiles and orientation handling are preserved.
- Crash records verify replacement contents before committing them. Android 9 and 10 check the backup rename before a write can overwrite the old record, and a completed save won't trigger a rollback. Recovery checks preference saves too. If a save fails, settings keep the controls paused and show a retry message. A successful recovery restores the saved theme immediately. Invalid preference types keep host startup disabled. Existing records remain readable.
- Development bundles can be validated while the public feed remains held. Validation checks both DEX files, including mapped section counts, bounds and referenced item starts, and the exact loaded catalog. Cached catalog comparisons preserve JSON types. Validation freezes the bundle with its checksum outside the build folder. The memory gate uses that snapshot and checks that its bytes stay unchanged. Release validation keeps its publication checks separate.
- File saves and restores can be canceled. Settings stop waiting after 30 seconds and release the screen when it closes. Late results can't change choices, and a storage app that ignores cancellation can't start unlimited background work. File slices retain their absolute boundaries, including files supplied with a different initial position. If you cancel a save, save again before you rely on that file.
- Repository links now use the HushMessenger artwork as their social preview.
- Manager 1.33.0 applied all 32 patches at its existing 640 MB process limit, with a peak heap of 290 MB. The signed result passed archive checks and kept every native library unchanged. Fresh-checkout reproduction and non-English setup diagnostics also passed. A development build updated an existing signed-in installation without replacing its key or losing its chat history.

HushPinterest 0.0.5 has 23 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0, and Pinterest 14.25.0 still patches the same way for phones on Android 9. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The big one is Download pin: it now saves image pins at full size. New this time are Remove ad tracking permissions, Hide topic suggestions and Spoof signature for Google sign-in, and Disable analytics turns off more of Google's collection.

## What's new

- Download pin now saves image pins. Pinterest's app is sent display sizes rather than the original for most pins, and the pin menu used to show "Download unavailable" for all of them. Now the download asks Pinterest's media host for the original behind the largest size and saves it, or saves that largest size when there's no original. Copy media link copies the same address, and Supplied media details says which size it describes. Thanks for the report in #2.
- Original-quality images now reaches pin closeups, not only collages. With it on, HushPinterest asks Pinterest for each pin's original along with its display sizes, and the closeup shows the original instead of the large size. Download pin then saves that original directly. Pins Pinterest already loaded keep their size until it loads them again.
- New Remove ad tracking permissions patch, on by default. It takes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services permissions and configuration out of Pinterest's manifest. There's no switch for it, so it stays until you patch again without it. While it's in, Google Play services hands Pinterest an all-zero ad ID even with Hide advertising ID turned off.
- Disable analytics now also turns off Firebase Crashlytics and Performance collection in the manifest, stops Google Analytics from collecting the ad ID, and sets Google's default consent for analytics storage, ad storage, ad user data and ad personalization to denied. Pinterest shipped all four consent defaults as granted. Like the Firebase Analytics flag, this stays until you patch again without the patch.
- New optional Hide topic suggestions patch. It hides the "Ideas you might love" row of topic bubbles under a pin, and the space it took closes up too. The switch starts off. Turn it off again, or pause HushPinterest, and the row comes back the next time Pinterest lays it out. Comments and related pins aren't touched.
- New Spoof signature for Google sign-in patch, off by default. It adds Pinterest's original signing certificate to the manifest so Google sign-in can work in the patched app. That only matters with microG-RE in place of Google Play services, or with the XSpoofSignatures LSPosed module and its permission granted. Stock Google Play services ignores it, and email and password sign-in never needed it.

## Update from 0.0.4

1. Morphe Manager offers 0.0.5 from the HushPinterest patch source. Patch the same Pinterest build you have now and install it over your current Pinterest. Your sign-in and switches stay, as long as Morphe Manager signs it with the same key as before.
2. Remove ad tracking permissions is new and selected by default. Hide topic suggestions and Spoof signature for Google sign-in are new and start unselected, so pick them in Morphe Manager if you want them. Hide topic suggestions also has a switch on the Interface page of HushPinterest settings.
3. Skip Spoof signature for Google sign-in unless your phone runs microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. On a phone with Google Play services it does nothing.

## New install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.38.0**, version code **14388010**, as the universal APK, and patch it. On Android 9, use Pinterest **14.25.0**, version code **14258020**.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 170 patch tests and 693 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto real Pinterest 14.38.0 and 14.25.0 APKs with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 23 patches applied to both without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.5.json` records each of those results, the APK hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

On a signed-in Android 16 phone running patched 14.38.0, Download pin saved the originals behind Pinterest's 736x size (a 541x721 PNG, and a 1134x1621 PNG for a 736x1052 pin), and Copy media link copied the same originals address. With Original-quality images on, the feed loaded, the closeup showed the original and Download pin saved a 1080x1080 JPEG. With Remove ad tracking permissions and the new Disable analytics manifest changes in, Pinterest launched to the signed-in feed without a crash, and the installed app no longer held the ad ID or ad services permissions.
